title: [codex] Sharp 7q stage-rank budget at arbitrary coupled width
body:
This proves a sharp **total stage-rank lower bound of7q** for every shortest five-query tuple on4q independent fields with three commuting compatible full-stage projectors satisfying their actual chronological-prefix conditions. Individual stage ranks may differ; arbitrary internal port coupling is allowed. The field has characteristic different from two.

The new point is the mixed-rank, arbitrary-width application of the actual prefix contract. An endpoint-adjacent full pair is compatible with the same square-zero query, so its intersection costs at least2q rather thanq. A further cross intersection contributesq, and the complete three-query Gram forces a union of dimension at least4q. The central site has an explicit4q invariant-space rank floor, covering every triple of positions. A unimodular ordinary frame attains(2q,3q,2q) with the literal independent-stage endpoint `S diag(ABC,AB,B,C)` at everyq.

A genuine q2 compatible rank13 shortest tuple is retained as a necessary scope control: its prefix commutators fail, so its tempting rank budget does not describe an independent-stage caller. This example is not priced or presented as a native improvement.

The scalar q1 obstruction, canonical scalar/block normal forms and basic image/row rank method are credited to Ali Romman's #6398 and `five-call-projector-rigidity`, following Cinna Davis's query/controller lineage. Exact predecessor bytes and notices are preserved. The new contribution is the uniform chronological mixed-rank budget and its carefully scoped attainment/control verification. Targeted repository overlap review found no matching coupled mixed-rank statement; no world priority is claimed.

Validation with Python3.12, standard library only:

- Generic package metadata and all Git/SHA256 provenance pins passed.
- Registered main normal/-O checks and separately written independent normal/-O checks all passed, total1.82s locally.
- The checks rebuild the shortest query Gram/ranks, central-site image/row closure, complete multivariate attaining endpoint and the rank13 missing-prefix counterexample.
- The universal result is supplied by the written proof; finite q controls corroborate conventions. Both implementations and the mathematical reviews are author-side AI-assisted checks.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-coupled-three-stage-rank-budget
```

This changes no selected-frontier file and claims no newκ, native supplier, paid-call invoice, physical phase certificate or multiplication theorem. The larger-n result is restricted to triples containing an endpoint-adjacent pair; arbitrary larger-n triples remain open. Prepared for thu-nmrc with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate proof/overlap/arithmetic review. Apache-2.0.
